[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Rhea's Crater | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=202 }} [[Rhea's Crater]] lies on the eastern end of [[the Jade Sea]]. The whole of the area appears to be a large [[Luxon]] quarry with deep excavation works being carried out in multiple places. The unearthed jade stands as a grim reminder of the day the Jade Sea became frozen, as the [[Petrified leviathan|preserved remains of fish, serpents, and other aquatic life forms]] can be seen within the jade blocks. The southern part of this area are narrow and deep pathways riddling through blocks of jade. The northern and middle portions are on higher ground with ledges where mining works are being carried out. The middle area also contains a small flooded section in the east. This area is crawling with [[:Category:The Jade Sea wildlife|Jade Sea wildlife]] and the [[Outcast]]s maintain long and fast patrols throughout this area. ==Getting there== Rhea's Crater can be reached via the eastern exit of [[Seafarer's Rest]], or through the [[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)|Gyala Hatchery explorable area]] from the [[Leviathan Pits]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection
